value: Xiong & Eickbush 1990, verified in rt07_g1 as assignment X04
rationale: The gate applies the founding paper's own stated rule instead of assuming modern RT1-RT7 boundaries: a position is conserved when the residue is present in over 50% of the elements of at least three of the four most abundant groups.
Verbatim from the criterion: 'present in over 50%'. Strictly greater than, not at least.
Verbatim: 'three of the four most abundant groups'.
Four lineage groups are present in ALIGN_000044 and are the paper's own subgroupings: mitochondrial, algal/chloroplast, euglenoid, bacterial.

value: all sequences assigned to the group, gaps included
rationale: 'Present in over 50% of the elements' counts elements, not occupied columns. Counting only non-gap sequences would let a column occupied by three sequences read as universally conserved.

value: BLOSUM-style chemical classes, reported alongside strict identity
rationale: Xiong & Eickbush describe conserved positions as 'identical or chemically similar', so both readings are landed and neither is presented alone.
The only stated coordinate boundary in the primary alignment record itself, landed by rt07_g1. The reconstruction is run inside it and, separately, over the whole alignment.
Merging conserved positions into blocks needs a maximum gap. The whole sweep is landed; no single value is privileged by fitting the answer.
A second free parameter, swept for the same reason.

value: the midpoint of the widest plateau in block count across the gap sweep, at min_conserved_positions = 2
rationale: DECLARED BEFORE ANY BLOCK WAS COUNTED. The rule selects a stable region of parameter space, never the parameter value that returns seven blocks. If seven blocks appear only at an isolated parameter value, this rule will not select it and the result lands as not recovered.

value: per block, the minimum and maximum start and end column across the whole sweep
rationale: A procedure without published residue edges cannot yield exact edges. The interval is the finding; a single number would be false precision.

value: column-wise shuffle within group, 200 replicates, same criterion
rationale: Answers whether block structure of this size arises from the alignment's composition alone. Declared before the observed value was known.

value: not reconstructed as a block; analysed only as N-terminal conservation in this substrate
rationale: Launcher section 1 and the g1 finding that RT0's scope claim is cross-class. A group II intron only alignment cannot test 'conserved only between group II intron and non-LTR RTs', so no RT0 block is created because later literature uses the name.

value: L.l. (AAB06503, Lactococcus lactis ltrB intron), ungapped length 599
rationale: Blocker 2005's LtrA. Used ONLY to test a reconstruction built without it; never to place a boundary.
